author_note: Read only the 13 workflow contracts in workflows/*.yaml and scripts/workflow_registry.py of the netzoo-core-p0-run worktree. Every gold was decided from the YAML contract text quoted in its evidence field: required inputs, controls with their allowed values and ranges, conventions, input_checks limits (min_samples, max_values, setting:kmax<=samples, relation:features>samples), granularities and handoff contracts. Size limits were computed explicitly (LIONESS-DRAGON values = feature pairs x samples, pairs counted with and without the diagonal so both readings agree). 'do' items include traps at allowed boundaries (lambda 0/1, exactly three samples, kmax equal to the sample count, delta 0.3 < 1/3, about 19.2M values, coexpression_file without expression, COBRA-adjusted co-expression into PANDA); 'dont' items each fail one quoted condition; 'ask' items carry the user's own stated uncertainty or conflict about one fact that flips fit; 'vague' items name no concrete result. Evidence quotes are verbatim from the named YAML file, with multi-line YAML text joined by single spaces; each quote was checked programmatically against the whitespace-normalised file. The registry was read for context only (it mirrors the YAML); no gold depends on registry-only text.
